classDiagram
direction LR
class CoreEventEnvelope {
 +ChatId streamId
 +BranchId branchId
 +uint64 sequence
 +EventId eventId
 +string kind
 +uint16 schemaVersion
 +SpanId spanId OPTIONAL
 +EventId causationEventId OPTIONAL
 +json payload
}
class SpanStartedData {
 +SpanId spanId
 +SpanId parentSpanId OPTIONAL
 +string spanKind
 +string semanticRole
 +json normalizedRedactedInput
 +ArtifactRef inputRef OPTIONAL
}
class SpanContentDeltaData {
 +SpanId spanId
 +string channel
 +string sourceClassification
 +string append
}
class SpanTerminalData {
 +SpanId spanId
 +string status COMPLETED_FAILED_CANCELLED
 +json normalizedRedactedOutput
 +ArtifactRef outputRef OPTIONAL
 +ErrorRef errorRef OPTIONAL
}
class ProjectionSnapshot {
 +ChatId streamId
 +uint64 throughSequence
 +string reducerVersion
 +Hash stateHash
 +json reducedSpanState
}
class SemanticSpan {
 +SpanId spanId
 +SpanId parentSpanId OPTIONAL
 +string spanKind
 +uint64 startSequence
 +uint64 terminalSequence OPTIONAL
}
CoreEventEnvelope --> SpanStartedData : SpanStarted
CoreEventEnvelope --> SpanContentDeltaData : SpanContentDelta
CoreEventEnvelope --> SpanTerminalData : terminal kind
SemanticSpan --> SpanStartedData : identity fixed by start
SemanticSpan "0..1" --> "0..*" SemanticSpan : owns children
ProjectionSnapshot --> SemanticSpan : reduced through sequence
CoreEventEnvelope --> CoreEventEnvelope : causation differs from ownership

data.title: Canonical Semantic Event and Hierarchical Span Contract
